meta.title: Vertix Labs · AI agents built for production
meta.description: Vertix Labs builds AI agents, automations and custom software for sales and customer service, with answers grounded in real data, automated tests and metrics from day one.

hero.title: AI agents built for production, not for demos.
hero.lead: Agents, automations and custom software for sales and customer service. Answers grounded in your data, automated tests on every change and metrics from day one.

items.name: QA Agent
items.outcome: Testing an AI agent used to take hours. Now it takes minutes.
how: One agent builds a battery of test scenarios from the business context.
Another talks to the agent under test the way a real customer would.
A judge agent reviews every conversation, scores it from 0 to 100 and points out error patterns.

items.name: X9 Agent
items.outcome: No client forgotten across dozens of WhatsApp groups.
how: Monitors client groups Monday to Friday and spots conversations with no real reply.
Runs two checks a day and flags who on the team hasn't answered.
Logs everything to a database and sends a weekly performance report, recognizing whoever hit 100%.

items.name: VSL Optimizer
items.outcome: Sales video briefs reviewed and rewritten in minutes, not days.
how: Six chained LLMs, each specialized in a copywriting framework, analyze the brief.
Each block gets a score from 0 to 10: opening, story and offer.
The system points out weak spots and delivers a new version ready to record.

items.name: Sales and support agents
items.text: They qualify leads, answer from your catalog and your rules, and hand the conversation to a person when needed. Connected to WhatsApp and your CRM.

items.name: Automations and integrations
items.text: No more copying and pasting between systems. CRM, WhatsApp, spreadsheets and internal tools exchanging data on their own, with a log of everything.

items.name: AI evaluation
items.text: Automated tests that measure an agent's quality on every prompt or model change, before a problem reaches a customer.

items.name: Custom software
items.text: Dashboards, web apps and internal tools designed around your process, not the other way around.

stack.title: Stack
stack.lead: Tools chosen to last in production.

about.title: AI engineering with a business mind.
paragraphs: Vertix Labs was born inside a sales operation, living with unanswered leads, overloaded teams and managers with no visibility into customer service.

That's why every project starts from the business problem and ends in something measurable. The agents answer from real data, go through automated tests on every change and are tracked with metrics from day one.
